title.zh: Who needs CLARITY anyway? ARB could see 70X increase: Hodler’s Digest
title.en: Who needs CLARITY anyway? ARB could see 70X increase: Hodler’s Digest

current_state.zh: The Senate's cloture vote on the CLARITY Act failed 49-50 despite a senator's procedural maneuver keeping a revived vote possible, while the same week saw tokenized stocks legalized and Standard Chartered projecting Arbitrum's price could rise 70-fold by 2030.
